text:
- Total revenue for TW was £135.3k, down 15.0% WoW from £159.1k in LW.
- TOTAL revenue was up 57.9% YoY against £85.7k in the LY week.
- TOTAL units reached 46,342 across 4,027 orders in TW, with units down 10.7% WoW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS led TW at £5,701.16 revenue, a 4.2% share of TOTAL.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT took £5,084.81 in TW (3.8% share) and fell £5,602.88 WoW; CHILLI LIGHTS took £4,960.25 (3.7% share) and rose £2,653.24 WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £3,543.60 and PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS £3,034.33 in TW, with the top five products at 16.5% of TOTAL revenue.
- CHILDRENS CUTLERY POLKADOT PINK gained £1,579.72 WoW and SPOTTY BUNTING gained £1,348.06 WoW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS lost £3,783.99 WoW and JUMBO BAG 50'S CHRISTMAS lost £2,568.26 WoW, while DOORMAT BLACK FLOCK rose 1,544.7% WoW and SET/3 VANILLA SCENTED CANDLE IN BOX rose 1,256.0% WoW.
